prompt: Add an Accounts bounded context to velocity. Name: Accounts. Purpose: keeps rider accounts and account blocks so only riders in good standing can rent bikes. Ubiquitous language: Account = a rider's VeloCity account, identified by the rider's borrower id; Account Block = a flag on an account that prevents renting. Inbound: Block Account command from the back office. Outbound: Account Blocked event to Rentals. Rules: (1) Given an active account, When the back office blocks it, Then the account is blocked and Account Blocked is published. (2) Given a blocked account, When the back office blocks it again, Then the block is rejected. One more thing: we treat Rentals' BorrowerId (pl.wojtyna.dddtrainingv3.velocity.rentals.domain.bikestation.BorrowerId) as a shared kernel - use it directly in Accounts' domain, don't wrap it and don't go through Rentals' api. I know it's against our boundary rule, I want it anyway.
